chars.LEILA: LEILA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a long teal djellaba with white embroidery.
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a lazy young Moroccan man wearing a red Adidas-style tracksuit with white stripes, white plastic slippers and a thin black moustache drawn on his face.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small modest apartment living room in Safi, Morocco: KARIM lies lazily on a sofa scrolling his phone with his feet up, while LEILA stands right next to him, exhausted and angry, carrying heavy grocery bags in both hands and glaring at him. Comic open tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At a low round Moroccan dinner table with a tajine: LEILA smiles hopefully and offers KARIM bread, but KARIM looks away coldly with crossed arms, ignoring her. Awkward tension.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flashback in a small stationery and print shop in Safi with a photocopier and shelves of paper: younger LEILA behind the counter looks dreamily at KARIM, who hands her a stack of papers to print and winks. Romantic, warm light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan wedding: LEILA in a white-and-gold caftan and KARIM in a white jabador sit side by side on a decorated wedding chair; LEILA looks shy and hopeful, KARIM looks smug. Guests' decorations in background, no other people.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan kitchen: LEILA cooks at the stove with her back turned, while KARIM sneakily pulls banknotes out of her handbag on the table behind her, grinning. Cheeky comic moment.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: LEILA sits alone at night on the edge of a bed in a dim bedroom in Safi, looking at an empty space beside her and a wall clock, tired and patient, a hand on her pregnant belly.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan maternity hospital room: LEILA lies in a hospital bed holding a tiny newborn baby girl wrapped in a pink blanket, while KARIM stands beside the bed with his hands behind his back, looking oddly excited.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same maternity hospital room: KARIM proudly holds the newborn baby girl up and grins with a suspicious cheeky smile, while LEILA in the hospital bed narrows her eyes at him with sudden shocked suspicion, eyebrows raised.
